raw.details:
HackSmart 2.0: An Opportunity to Reimagine Mobility

HackSmart is back for its second edition!

Organised by Battery Smart × Geek Room, HackSmart 2.0 brings together developers, students, working professionals, and innovators to build practical solutions for real-world challenges in electric mobility.

From battery swapping and operational efficiency to automation and technology-driven solutions, participants will get the opportunity to work on industry-relevant challenges, collaborate with fellow builders, and showcase their ideas to industry experts.

New challenges. Fresh ideas. Bigger possibilities.

Event Details

  • Organisers: Battery Smart × Geek Room

  • Venue: Battery Smart Office, Sector 62, Gurugram, Haryana

  • Format: Offline Hackathon

  • Registration Period: 7th November – 15th December 2026

  • Hackathon Dates: 6th February – 7th February 2027

How to Register

  • Register through the official HackSmart 2.0 listing on Unstop.

  • Complete your personal and professional details.

  • Enter your team details. Individual registrations are also welcome.

Hackathon Structure

1. Registration & Team Formation

Register individually or as a team and connect with fellow participants. Complete the registration process to be considered for the shortlisting round.

2. Profile Shortlisting

Participant profiles will be reviewed by the organising team. Shortlisting will consider participants' professional backgrounds, experience, skills, and technical profiles.

3. Kickoff & Build Sprint

Selected participants will attend an orientation covering the problem statements, evaluation criteria, and event guidelines before beginning the development phase. Mentors will be available to provide technical guidance and feedback.

4. Project Demonstration

Teams will present their solutions to the jury through a 10-minute demonstration, showcasing their approach, implementation, and potential impact. The top five teams will advance to the final round.

5. Final Jury Pitch

The top five teams will present their solutions in a 7-minute final pitch, followed by the jury's evaluation and winner announcements.

Prizes & Rewards

HackSmart 2.0 features ₹1,00,000 in cash prizes, along with additional rewards and career opportunities.

  • Winner: ₹50,000 cash

  • First Runner-up: ₹30,000 cash

  • Second Runner-up: ₹20,000 cash

  • Amazon Cash Vouchers: Worth ₹20,000

Special Prize: PlayStation 5 + GTA VI

One outstanding team will also have the opportunity to win a PlayStation 5 + GTA VI, worth ₹50,000.

Important: This is a separate special award with its own judging criteria. It is independent of the main competition rankings, meaning a team can win this prize regardless of whether it finishes first, second, or third in the main competition.

Pre-Placement Interview Opportunities

HackSmart 2.0 also offers participants an opportunity to explore potential career opportunities with Battery Smart.

Participants with at least 6 months to 1 year of professional experience, who can commit the required time and availability expected by the company, will be eligible for a pre-placement interview opportunity.

This is an interview opportunity, not a guaranteed job offer. Final hiring decisions will depend on the company's selection process.

This opportunity will be provided in place of participation certificates.

Evaluation Criteria

Projects will be evaluated based on:

  • Innovation: Originality and creativity of the proposed solution.

  • Technical Implementation: Quality of development and execution.

  • Feasibility: Practicality and applicability in real-world scenarios.

  • Scalability: Potential to expand and create broader impact.

  • Industry Relevance: How effectively the solution addresses real-world mobility challenges.

About the Organisers

Battery Smart

Battery Smart is building an ecosystem for electric mobility through its battery-swapping network, helping make electric vehicle adoption more accessible and convenient.

Geek Room

Geek Room is a global developer community connecting 150,000+ developers across 400+ colleges and 20+ chapters, bringing together builders through hackathons, technical initiatives, and community-led events.

Ready to Build?

Bring your ideas, collaborate with fellow innovators, and work on challenges shaping the future of electric mobility.

Whether you're a student, developer, working professional, or independent builder, HackSmart 2.0 is your opportunity to turn ideas into impactful solutions.

Register now and be part of HackSmart 2.0!

prizes.others: The team securing the first position in the main judging round will receive ₹50,000 in cash.
The team securing the second position in the main judging round will receive ₹30,000 in cash.
The team securing the third position in the main judging round will receive ₹20,000 in cash.

An additional special prize featuring a PlayStation 5 and GTA VI, worth ₹50,000, will be awarded to one outstanding team.  Important: This prize will be decided through a separate judging criterion and evaluation process. It is independent of the main winner and runner-up rankings. Any team can win this prize, regardless of its position in the main competition.
Amazon cash vouchers worth ₹20,000 will be awarded as an additional prize in kind to selected participants or teams, based on the organiser's allocation.

Eligible participants will get an opportunity to interview for potential roles with the company.  This opportunity is open to participants who:  Have at least 6 months of relevant professional experience.  Can commit the required time and availability expected by the company.  Please note: This is a pre-placement interview opportunity, not a guaranteed job offer. Final selection will depend on the company's interview and hiring process. This opportunity is provided instead of participation certificates.
